meta.name: anki
meta.description: Builds and repairs Anki decks: card writing, FSRS and SM-2 deck options, leeches, review workload, imports, and sync. Use when making cards from notes, PDFs, lectures, textbooks, or vocabulary lists; when reviews pile up, take too long, or a backlog builds after time off; when retention drops, cards keep failing, or a deck falls into ease hell; when choosing FSRS vs SM-2, or setting desired retention, new cards per day, learning steps, and leech thresholds; when a deck asks to upload or download in a one-way sync, loses media, or fails Check Database; when importing CSV/TSV, an .apkg, or a shared deck, or migrating from Quizlet, Memrise, or SuperMemo; when cards are due but nothing appears; and when a fixed exam date forces a study plan. Covers language decks, medical and board decks, code and math material, and personal decks such as names and faces or poetry. Not for generic flashcard writing outside Anki, spaced-repetition algorithm theory, study-session planning, or add-on development.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 构建和修复 Anki 牌组，自动生成卡片并优化复习
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你的学习依赖 Anki 牌组，需要高效制作和优化复习计划
copy.tagline_en: Build and repair Anki decks, auto-generate cards and optimize review settings
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you rely on Anki decks for learning and need efficient card creation and review optimization

howto.what: 装上此技能后，Claude 能根据笔记、PDF、讲座等材料生成可导入 Anki 的卡片；诊断牌组问题（如积压、遗忘率下降、卡牌频繁失败）；配置 FSRS 或 SM-2 的牌组选项；处理同步、导入等应用问题；以及制定考试复习计划。
howto.when: 当你需要从学习材料制作卡片、分析牌组表现、设置牌组参数，或遇到 Anki 应用异常（如同步提示、媒体丢失）时触发。

say.text: 从这份 PDF 生成 Anki 卡片
say.note: Claude 会提取关键事实并生成可导入的卡片文本。

say.text: 我的牌组最近积压严重，怎么回事？
say.note: Claude 会分析复习量、新卡数等参数并给出调整建议。

say.text: 帮我设置 FSRS 目标保留率 0.90
say.note: Claude 会指导你在牌组选项中修改保留率并解释影响。

howto.what_en: With this skill, Claude can create importable Anki cards from notes, PDFs, lectures, etc.; diagnose deck problems (backlog, retention drop, failed cards); configure FSRS or SM-2 deck options; handle sync, import, and other app problems; and plan study for fixed exam dates.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to make cards from source material, analyze deck performance, set deck options, or resolve Anki app issues (sync prompts, missing media, etc.).

say_en.text: Generate Anki cards from this PDF
say_en.note: Claude will extract atomic facts and output importable card text.

say_en.text: My deck has a big backlog, what's wrong?
say_en.note: Claude will analyze review load, new card limits, etc., and suggest fixes.
Claude will guide you on changing the retention setting and its workload impact.
